source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.fruits: Bur-like, coiled 2–5 turns, with hooked prickles generally present
morphology_source_reported.stipules: Upper stipules divided more than halfway to base [key, p. 674]
morphology_source_reported.pedicels: Shorter than calyx lobes, some flowers nearly sessile [key, p. 674]
morphology_source_reported.leaflet_spot: No prominent central purple-red mark [key p. 674; contrast with M. arabica]

habitat_source_reported: Sandy, less often clayey, pastures, lawns and roadsides
cautions: Source morphology has not been independently corroborated or approved for identification scoring
Regional habitat and distribution do not establish Hays County nativity
